json.evidence: Only one main load center is visible: the gray panel beside the meter socket, shown open with breakers in photos 2-4, 7 and 13. The added equipment is a white BASE-branded gateway/transfer enclosure, two small disconnect switches, battery cabinets and an inverter. None of these is a second load center with its own service main breaker. The gateway is conduit-connected to the existing panel and meter area.
json.notes: The new installation is battery/backup equipment, a gateway and disconnects. By the rules, these do not count as a second main panel. Any backup-loads subpanel would be downstream. Only one true service main panel is present.
